name: s81hc_ctrnown_e_ref
why_floorplan: Stacked split of the ctrn_col_e return slice (10-16 a5): ctrn_col a3 (144.18x25.92, 1,140 b) failed GRT-0116 only in the N-face output band (10.5 pins/um: output flop + hold stage per bit in the top ~4 um; M3/M5 1-4 tracks over, usage 23-25%); a4 at 34.56 still shows the band red at the gate. Split: own 628 b per 144.18x25.92 leaf, ~5 pins/um per face, same x per bit; own leaf at the tile top (N).

job.purpose: cth_ntc return slice, stacked split (retrow CTRN_SPLIT 1): own leaf N: rv (row flag merge) + hdr + own a/b, 628 b
job.hold_merge: cth_ntc parent component: the parent kit binds it after every child closes with native PASS; exactness = two-row chain proof + exact HC gate (RETCOL)

pin_regs.reason: Real RTL registers the boundary at its own stage (chain rd/rv -> rdq/rvq, y beat / cs relays, ybuf / psb captures, rdm / header / request / flag registers); a generic pin register would add a cycle to the fixed return calendar. hrq feeds the same-cycle merge (bank round trip) by design.

structural_change: ctrn_col_{e,w} (one register, 1,140 b) split into ctrn_own (rv/flag merge/hdr/own a,b) + ctrn_par (partner a,b): identical registers, reset and flag merge (ot_s81_hc_ctrn_own / ot_s81_hc_ctrn_par, retrow CTRN_SPLIT 1), 0 cycles. Parent cth_ntc 874.26 -> 900.18 (slice row 51.84); rows below keep their distance from the tile bottom; chain legs +25.92 (max 488.3 um), to_slice max 346.4, partner legs unchanged (623.4). | 10-16 a6: a5 CLOSED (TT +284.54 / FF +16.92) but native launch 224.7 > 220 at hdr_out[37] (2 pins, the hdr cluster x 0-13, 8.8 pins/um; capture 171.5 OK): each hdr flop was anchored at its hdr_c INPUT pin (first BTerm seen), so the N-face launch carried the 22-um crossing. OT_OFLOP_PORT_RE ^(rv_|flg_|a_own|b_own|hdr_out) (every port but hdr_c): the hdr flops anchor at their hdr_out pins instead (capture side has 18 ps margin). Same RTL, pins, outline, 0 cycles. | a7 (HC-COL 1815): a6 CLOSED TT +288.92 / FF +19.09, native launch fixed (217.3) but capture 192.5 > 190 at flg_fault[0] (2 pins): the rv/flag-merge flops are anchored at the rv_c / flag input face (S) instead of rv_out (N); same RTL/pins/outline, 0 cycles.
